title: pvGlyph
body:
## pvGlyph

Places a copy of a glyph shape (arrow, cone, cube, cylinder, line, sphere or 2-D glyph, GlyphType) at points of the input, or at cell centres when the chosen arrays are cell data, oriented by a vector array and scaled by a scalar or vector array; output is polydata. Use it for velocity arrows or sized markers. Use pvGlyphWithCustomSource to glyph with your own geometry.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- By ParaView default only up to 5000 points are glyphed (Uniform Spatial Distribution); choose All Points or Every Nth Point when every point must appear.
- OrientationArray and ScaleArray must have the same association; a point/cell mismatch makes the native filter warn and produce no glyphs.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Glyph`. Identity: `filters/Glyph`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to this filter. This is the dataset from which the locations are selected to be glyphed. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphMode` | This property indicates the mode that will be used to generate glyphs from the dataset. | `{"type":"enum","values":["All Points","Every Nth Point","Uniform Spatial Distribution (Bounds Based)","Uniform Spatial Distribution (Surface Sampling)","Uniform Spatial Distribution (Volume Sampling)"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"All Points"` |
| `GlyphTransform` | The values in this property allow you to specify the transform (translation, rotation, and scaling) to apply to the glyph source. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Transform2"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Transform2"}` |
| `GlyphType` | This property determines which type of glyph will be placed at the points in the input dataset. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["2D Glyph","Arrow","Box","Cone","Cylinder","Line","Sphere"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Arrow"}` |
| `MaximumNumberOfSamplePoints` | This property specifies the maximum number of sample points to use when sampling the space when Uniform Spatial Distribution is used. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OrientationArray` | Select the input array to use for orienting the glyphs. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScaleArray` | Select the input array to be used for scaling the glyphs. If the scale array is a vector array, you can control how the glyphs are scaled with the **Vector Scale Mode** property. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScaleFactor` | Specify the constant multiplier to use to scale the glyphs. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Seed` | This property specifies the seed that will be used for generating a uniform distribution of glyph points when a Uniform Spatial Distribution is used. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Stride` | This property specifies the stride that will be used when glyphing by Every Nth Point. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `VectorScaleMode` | Select the mode when the scaling array is a vector. **Scale by Magnitude** scales the glyph by the vector magnitude. **Scale by Components** scales glyphs by each vector component in the dimension that component represents, e.g., the x-direction is scaled by component 0, the y-direction is scaled by component 1, and so on. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Scale by Magnitude","Scale by Components"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Scale by Magnitude"` |

### Nested `GlyphTransform` → `Transform2`

Syntax: `{"type":"Transform2","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `extended_sources/Transform2`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Rotate` | Rotation [rx, ry, rz] of the glyph shape about its local axes, combined in VTK’s Z-X-Y convention (the matrix is RotateZ · RotateX · RotateY); for a rotation about a single axis the order does not matter. The operation then turns the glyph’s x axis onto the orientation vector, so this rotation changes which part of the shape follows the vector. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Scale` | Scale factors [sx, sy, sz] applied to the glyph shape along its local axes before any other scaling, for example to make arrows thinner without shortening them. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphTransform.options.Translate` | Offset [tx, ty, tz] of the glyph shape, applied after its scale and rotation; for example [-0.5, 0, 0] centres a unit-length arrow on the data point. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `2D Glyph`

Syntax: `{"type":"2D Glyph","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/GlyphSource2D`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Offset [x, y, z] of the symbol from its local origin, i.e. from the data point after glyphing. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.DoublePointed` | When true, the arrow gets a second head at its other end (the -x end), drawn with the same TipLength, so the glyph points both ways along the orientation vector. With PointInwards the shaft is shortened by one TipLength per head and cannot become shorter than zero. Only used when GlyphType is Arrow. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.Filled` | When true, closed symbols are drawn as filled polygons; when false only their outline is drawn. It only applies to closed symbols. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.GlyphType` | Symbol to draw. Arrow, ThickArrow, HookedArrow and EdgeArrow point along +x and therefore follow the orientation vector; Dash is a short line along x; Vertex is a single point; Cross, ThickCross, Triangle, Square, Circle and Diamond are position markers. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Vertex","Dash","Cross","ThickCross","Triangle","Square","Circle","Diamond","Arrow","ThickArrow","HookedArrow","EdgeArrow"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Vertex"` |
| `GlyphType.options.PointInwards` | When true, the arrow tip(s) point inwards instead of outwards. Only used when GlyphType is “Arrow”. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.TipLength` | Length of the arrow tip as a fraction of the unit glyph length. Only used when GlyphType is “Arrow”. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Arrow`

Syntax: `{"type":"Arrow","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/ArrowSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Invert` | When true, the tip is at (0, 0, 0) and the shaft base at (1, 0, 0): after glyphing the arrow lies on the same side of the data point but points back toward it, as for flow arriving at the point. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.ShaftRadius` | Radius of the cylindrical shaft as a fraction of the arrow length. | `{"maximum":5.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.ShaftResolution` | Number of facets around the shaft; higher values look rounder but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"maximum":128,"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `GlyphType.options.TipLength` | Length of the conical tip as a fraction of the total arrow length (the shaft takes the rest). | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.TipRadius` | Radius of the widest part of the tip (the cone base) as a fraction of the arrow length. | `{"maximum":10.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.TipResolution` | Number of facets around the tip cone: 1 gives a single triangle, 2 two crossed triangles, higher values a rounder cone. | `{"maximum":128,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Box`

Syntax: `{"type":"Box","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/CubeSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the box relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.XLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local x axis (the axis aligned with the vector or major eigenvector). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.YLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local y axis (the medium eigenvector in Tensor Glyph). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.ZLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local z axis (the minor eigenvector in Tensor Glyph). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Cone`

Syntax: `{"type":"Cone","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/ConeSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Capping` | When true, the base of the cone is closed with a polygon; when false it is open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the cone, which is the midpoint of its axis (not the centre of its base), relative to the glyph’s local origin, i.e. the data point. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Direction` | Direction from the base centre toward the apex; it need not be normalized. It is relative to the glyph’s local axes, whose x axis Glyph aligns with the vector, so keep [1, 0, 0] for cones that point along the vector. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Height` | Length of the cone along Direction, from base centre to apex; Center sits at half this length. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Radius` | Radius of the cone’s base; with Height it sets how slender or blunt each cone looks before the operation scales it. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Resolution` | Number of sides around the cone: 0 gives a line, 1 a single triangle, 2 two crossed triangles, and larger values a cone with that many sides. | `{"maximum":512,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Cylinder`

Syntax: `{"type":"Cylinder","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/CylinderSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Capping` | When true, both ends of the cylinder are closed with polygons; when false they are open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the cylinder relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Height` | Length of the cylinder along its local y axis, split equally either side of Center. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Radius` | Radius of the cylinder’s circular cross-section; with Height it sets how thick each glyph is relative to its length. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Resolution` | Number of facets around the cylinder; higher values look rounder but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"maximum":512,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Line`

Syntax: `{"type":"Line","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/LineSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Point1` | Start of the line in glyph-local coordinates; [0, 0, 0] starts it at the data point. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Point2` | End of the line in glyph-local coordinates; keep it on +x so the line follows the vector. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.RefinementRatios` | Positions along the line, as fractions from 0 (Point1) to 1 (Point2), where points are placed when UseRegularRefinement is false. Include 0 and 1 to keep the end points. | `{"items":{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[0.0]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Resolution` | Number of equal segments (Resolution + 1 points) when UseRegularRefinement is true. A straight glyph looks the same at any value; more points only add data. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `GlyphType.options.UseRegularRefinement` | When true, points are spaced evenly using Resolution; when false, they are placed at the fractions listed in RefinementRatios. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Sphere`

Syntax: `{"type":"Sphere","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/SphereSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the sphere relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.EndPhi` | Ending latitude measured from the +z pole; 90 gives the upper hemisphere, 180 the full sphere. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.EndTheta` | Ending longitude about the local z axis; less than 360 leaves the sphere open. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.PhiResolution` | Number of divisions in latitude (phi, measured from the +z pole) between StartPhi and EndPhi. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `GlyphType.options.Radius` | Radius of the sphere; the static 0.5 gives a glyph of unit diameter before the operation’s scaling. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.StartPhi` | Starting latitude measured from the +z pole (0) toward the −z pole (180); values above 0 cut off a cap at the top. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.StartTheta` | Starting longitude, about the local z axis; with EndTheta it lets you draw only a wedge of the sphere. A full sphere uses 0 to 360. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.ThetaResolution` | Number of divisions around the sphere in longitude (theta, about the local z axis) between StartTheta and EndTheta; higher values look rounder but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,

}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGlyph",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
